HackerNews - no new AI tool launches relevant to print today
Category gap analysis: Midjourney missing from all reviews (critical SEO gap)
Industry Knowledge: 10 trending AI tools for print/e-commerce/POD

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.description: Premium AI image generator widely considered best for print-quality visual design — t-shirt graphics, poster art, packaging mockups, and brand imagery.
pros: Highest aesthetic quality among all AI image generators
Print-resolution output (upscalable to 4K+)
Best for t-shirt graphics and poster art
Active community with millions of style references
cons: Discord-only interface (learning curve for non-tech users)

tools.name: Pebblely
tools.description: AI product photography platform purpose-built for e-commerce — generates photorealistic product scenes from a single flat product photo.
pros: Stunning photorealistic backgrounds from single product photo
Works with any product type (clothing, electronics, books)
AI auto-crops and centers product perfectly
Batch processing for catalog-scale output
cons: Backgrounds can look AI-generated on close inspection
No physical mockup templates (e.g. t-shirt display)

tools.name: Claid AI
tools.description: AI product photo enhancement API and web tool — background removal, upscaling, color correction, and retouching optimized for e-commerce catalogs.
pros: All-in-one enhancement: bg removal + upscale + color fix
API-first design for high-volume catalog processing
Batch retouching saves hours per week
Shopify plugin available
cons: Web tool UI is functional but basic

tools.name: Topaz Photo AI
tools.description: Professional AI image quality enhancement suite — upscaling, denoising, and sharpening for print-ready output. Essential tool for print shops processing customer artwork.
pros: Best-in-class upscaling to 16K for large-format printing
One-time payment, no subscription
Denoise + sharpen + upscale in one workflow
Batch processing for production workflows
cons: $199 high upfront cost for casual users
Requires good GPU for fast processing

tools.name: VistaCreate (formerly Crello)
tools.description: AI-powered graphic design platform with 100K+ print-ready templates — flyers, posters, business cards, social media graphics, and packaging mockups.
pros: 70K+ print-ready templates available
AI background removal and smart resize included
Free version with generous template access
Brand kits for consistent print materials
cons: Export resolution limited on free plan
Less advanced than Canva for complex designs

tools.name: LogoAI
tools.price: Free preview / $49 one-time (HD files + brand kit)
tools.description: AI logo maker generating print-ready logo files in SVG, EPS, PDF, and PNG — with full brand kit (business cards, letterheads, social media).
pros: SVG/Vector export for print (unlimited scaling)
Full brand kit included in one payment
AI suggests styles based on industry + keywords
Cheaper than hiring a designer
cons: Logo quality depends on input keywords
Some results look generic or template-like

tools.name: PosterMyWall
tools.description: AI-powered poster and flyer design platform with print-ready templates optimized for local print shops, events, and retail promotions.
pros: Massive library of 100K+ poster templates
Print-ready PDF export (CMYK + bleed)
Affordable $9.95/mo premium
Great for small print shop marketing
cons: AI features are basic compared to Canva/Kittl
Good for templates, weak for original design

tools.name: Custom Ink Design Lab
tools.price: Free (design tool) / pay per t-shirt shipped
tools.description: AI-powered t-shirt design tool with clip art library, text effects, and print-ready export — built into the Custom Ink POD platform.
pros: T-shirt-specific AI design features
Huge clip art and font library
Print-ready output with color separation
All-in-one design + fulfillment
cons: Design tool limited to apparel only

tools.name: Bing Image Creator (DALL-E Powered)
tools.description: Free AI image generator powered by DALL-E — integrated with Bing Chat and Microsoft Designer. Useful for print design inspiration and rapid prototyping.
pros: Completely free with Microsoft account
Powered by DALL-E — good prompt adherence
Generates 4 images per prompt
No usage cap on free plan

tools.name: AutoDraw by Google
tools.description: Google's free AI drawing tool — turns rough sketches into clean vector clip art. Great for quick print design elements when you have no design skills.
pros: Completely free, no account needed
Works on any device with a browser
Vector output (SVG-compatible)
Perfect for quick design elements
cons: Limited to simple clip art (no complex designs)
Not suitable for final product design
